text.tspan: GAP-MW-016: Conceptual signal contracts remain nominal until signal identity, units, freshness, and conversion rules are baselined.
GAP-MW-017: System service discovery, authentication, and binding contracts remain technology-neutral and incomplete until physical interface selection.
GAP-MW-018: Ownership and failure-response semantics for safety-path protection remain open pending safety analysis and physical realization.
Conceptual responsibility for translating and exposing vehicle-signal access without selecting a signal schema or transport.
Conceptual responsibility for proxying diagnostic requests and responses across the middleware boundary.
Conceptual responsibility for coordinating application-visible lifecycle state with middleware lifecycle state.
Conceptual responsibility for forwarding service health and availability status.
Conceptual responsibility for coordinating integration updates without selecting an update mechanism.
Conceptual responsibility for service discovery, authentication boundary handling, and service binding.
Technology-neutral logical composition of the middleware integration responsibilities.
Reviewers need the conceptual system decomposition, conceptual element
responsibilities, and ownership boundaries to be visible.
Reviewers need the typed conceptual interfaces, exchanges, directions,
and delegation from the conceptual system boundary to internal elements.
Reviewers need every system function allocated to one or more logical
elements without implying a physical or software implementation.
Expose the part-usage subtree, not the package: the interconnection
renderer draws part usages with their ports and flow edges; a
package-level expose resolves to definitions, which are skipped.
